overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for long-running campaigns and optimizing endgame tick processing. This batch focuses on reducing memory footprint and improving cache locality for the 5,500+ tick milestone, ensuring zero deadlocks and 100% Monte Carlo survival rate stability.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compression
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::span for contiguous memory access. Implement a fixed-size ring buffer for state deltas. Utilize C++20 concepts for type-safe serialization. No dynamic allocations in hot path. Use std::bit_cast for efficient integer packing. Ensure all operations are constexpr-friendly where possible.
acceptance_criteria: Memory usage reduced by >40% for 5,500 tick state.
All unit tests pass with 100% coverage.
Deterministic output verified against BATCH-26 baseline.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster load times and smoother frame rates in long campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Endgame Tick Processing with SIMD
tasks.architectural_spec: Leverage C++20 std::simd for vectorized physics calculations. Align data structures to 64-byte boundaries. Implement branchless logic for collision detection in the final 100 ticks. Use std::array for fixed-size physics state.
acceptance_criteria: No regressions in Monte Carlo survival rate.
SIMD instructions verified via compiler output.
tasks.player_fun_impact: More responsive physics interactions in late-game scenarios.

tasks.title: Cache-Friendly Colonist Psychology State Lookup
tasks.architectural_spec: Flatten psychology state into a single contiguous array. Use std::span for iteration. Implement a simple hash map with open addressing for quick state lookups. Ensure all structs are trivially copyable.
acceptance_criteria: Lookup time reduced to <10ns per colonist.
No deadlocks in parallel psychology updates.
Unit tests confirm deterministic state transitions.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother AI behavior transitions and reduced stutter.
